description: Providers review history and document visits; orders and results
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety (allergies/medications unavailable); about $38K revenue per clinic day; providers cannot see full record
source_evidence: EV-032 (Medical Director interview); EV-028 (revenue); EV-029 (visit volume)
manual_workaround: Paper downtime forms and printed next-day schedules; defer non-urgent visits

mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Front-desk flow stops; eligibility errors cause denied claims
manual_workaround: Printed daily schedule; paper registration; phone eligibility checks

description: New prescriptions and refills including controlled substances
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients cannot obtain medications; controlled-substance e-prescribing requires the certified EHR module
manual_workaround: Phone-in or paper prescriptions where state and federal law allow

mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Orthopedic visits rely on same-day imaging; images can be re-acquired but repeat exposure is avoided
source_evidence: EV-032 (Clinic A Manager interview); EV-011 (backup schedule)
manual_workaround: Refer to outside imaging center; modality stores studies locally for about 7 days

description: Send orders and receive results through interface engine
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Critical results must reach providers; lab also phones critical values
manual_workaround: Lab portal and fax; lab phones critical results

description: Charge capture; claim submission; payment posting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $190K billed per week; payers accept late claims within filing limits
source_evidence: EV-032 (Billing Manager interview); EV-028 (revenue by payer)
manual_workaround: Queue charges; submit when restored; draw on line of credit

description: Portal messages; phones; referral faxes; telehealth
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients need to reach the practice; referrals and records requests have deadlines
manual_workaround: Phone tree to cell phones; paper fax at Clinic A
dependent_third_parties: Fax and telehealth vendors; phone carrier

description: Time capture; payroll; onboarding and termination
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; missing payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through payroll provider
